lines.text: Now then, how's the shoulder since last time? It's four weeks since the op now.
Since last time I can wash my hair with that arm, I'm moving a bit better.
Brilliant. What are you taking for pain?
Just what the hospital gave me. I've got the packet.
So that's paracetamol 500 milligrams, two tablets four times a day, and you can drop to two times a day when you're comfortable.
Let me have a look. Lift up in front of you. That's a hundred and twenty degrees, up from ninety.
You can leave the sling off at home now, wear it on the bus though.
Ta-ra, love, see you in a fortnight.
Hiya, come in, you're Mr Booth? I'm Kath.
Aye, that's me. It's my lower back, I've had sciatica down my left leg for a fortnight.
